Name: Lannah - Female Lance
Author: Nom0ri
Description:
[b][font=Comic Sans MS][size=3][center]Are you on a quest to turn every magic user in Stardew Vally into a female?
Then you're in a good place.
This mod has the goal of fully transforming the Combat Mage Lance into his female version
Lannah[/center][/size][/font][/b]
[font=Comic Sans MS][size=4][b]Contents[/b]:[/size][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Tahoma][size=2]Turns Lance into Lannah[/size][/font]
[*][font=Tahoma][size=2]All dialogues are reworked to match the new gender and name[/size][/font]
[*][font=Tahoma][size=2]Corrected events and quests[/size][/font]
[*][font=Tahoma][size=2]New portrait and sprite (seasonals included)[/size][/font]
[/list][size=4]
[font=Comic Sans MS][b]Compatibility:[/b][/font]
[/size][font=Tahoma]If you're using [i]Legacy [/i]appearance, you [b]must [/b]disable Lance in the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969][i]Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE[/i][/url] config file.
If you're using [i]Default [/i]appearance[i] and Seasonals[/i], you [b]don’t need[/b] to do anything, the files will overwrite automatically, and it will work fine together.
Still, I recommend disabling Lance in [i]Seasonal Cuter Aesthetic[/i] no matter which version you use. It helps the game load faster and avoid conflicts.[/font]

[size=4][b][font=Comic Sans MS]Ko-fi:[/font][/b]
[/size][font=Tahoma]If by some weird chance you'd like to support me, here's my [url=https://ko-fi.com/nomori]ko-fi [/url]page.[/font]

[size=4][font=Comic Sans MS][b]Translations:[/b][/font]
[/size][font=Tahoma]Before you post new translations please DM me or ask in the comments. I'd rather avoid multiple translations for the same language in case existing one still works. AI translations are not allowed, since many things can't be translated literally.﻿﻿[/font]
